messages:
alex: kicking off tf apply to prod in quiet window (slot 3) — iam + eip changes. @sam @maria watch pls. expecting canary then serial.

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECKS OK
- plan changed resources: 6 to add, 2 to change
- drift detected in module/network: route_table

sam: can you paste the plan output? esp IAM diffs.

alex: pasted plan snippet:
```
# aws_iam_role.app_role will be updated in-place
- assume_role_policy = ... -> changed
# aws_eip.prod_eip[0] will be created
+ resource "aws_eip" "prod_eip" ...
```

maria: FYI if role policy changes we need Okta svcaccount rotation; slow canary ok but watch auth logs.

deploybot: starting apply slot=1 (canary) by @alex

deploybot: APPLY ERROR
```
Error: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole denied for arn:aws:iam::123456:role/infra-deploy
at resource aws_iam_role.app_role
```

ryan-oncall: I'm up, seeing elevated auth fails in metrics dashboard. Recommend abort apply and evacuate slot. This looks like a passrole policy missing in new role.

sam: agree. abort and rollback to previous state snapshot (snap-20260320-0200). Also flag a postmortem.

alex: running abort and rollback now
```
> deploybot abort 3645012345
> deploybot rollback --snapshot=snap-20260320-0200 --target=aws_iam_role.app_role
```

deploybot: abort acknowledged. starting rollback to snap-20260320-0200. ETA ~4m

maria: pinging security to authorize temporary PassRole grant for the deploy principal; will follow up in ticket #SEC-478

deploybot: rollback complete. state restored. No resources changed after canary.

alex: thanks all. we'll hold the rest of the apply window until sec confirms PassRole grant and we update plan to be idempotent. filing release note entry and tagging for next release. :white_check_mark:

sam: adding to release notes & owning the postmortem. link to runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/infra/apply-evac

ryan-oncall: please update oncall handoff; I'll monitor for any delayed auth errors.

maria: leaving a reminder to pin provider version in the terraform module; that likely caused different behaviour across envs.

alex: agreed — will pin provider and re-run preflight in staging. moving remaining apply to follow-up change window.

sam: +1

deploybot: thread closed by user alex
